payload.title: P5-10: Staging site (Cognito-gated drafts) under /information
payload.description:
## Goal
A staging site on `staging.p.apyr.us` shows draft articles as published under `/information`, behind Cognito (editors and admins only), reading the production backend, with the marketing page also gated.

## Context (FACT)
- Template staging: branch `staging` of the same app (`SITE_ENV=staging`, `PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE=drafts`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_STAGING_URL`), frontend-only, no second backend (epic decision). Middleware gate (`lib/staging-gate.ts`): anonymous -> redirect to `/newsroom` (hardcoded), non-editor -> 403, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`, `/robots.txt` disallow all.
- The gate exempts only `/newsroom`, `/api`, static and robots, so `/` (marketing) and `/information` are both gated on staging: wanted.
- Session cookies come from the Amplify server adapter; cookie path and domain across `/` and `/information` are UNVERIFIED (read of staging-gate.ts shows no explicit path); probed here.
- Staging host from the template (TI PPY-4f2519 explicit staging host).
- The old app has no staging.

## Exact steps
1. Ryan connects the `staging` branch (console, same sitting as P5-07 if possible).
2. Create a draft Item in /newsroom; confirm it appears under `/information` on staging only.
3. Probes (below), with a real editor and a non-editor Google account.
4. Confirm `PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW` / `SITE_ENV` absent from `main`.

## Acceptance checks
- Anonymous `GET https://staging.p.apyr.us/` and `/information`: exactly one redirect to `/newsroom`, no loop; `/newsroom` 200.
- Editor session: `/` renders marketing, `/information` lists the draft, the article URL under `/information/YYYY/<month>/DD/<slug>` renders; non-editor: 403 text.
- Response headers contain `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`; staging `/robots.txt` disallows all; production `main` `/robots.txt` allows.
- The draft does not appear on production.

## Rollback
Delete the `staging` branch; production unaffected.

## Risks
Cookie scope bug between `/` and `/information` (fix in Papyrus if found, new ticket); 6 MB response limit for large assets on WEB_COMPUTE.

## Needs Ryan
Console branch connect; sign-in as editor and non-editor for the probes.
